Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football 2026/2027 GPL: Medeama beat AshantiGold to stay top Source : Daniel Koranteng 22 November 2026 4:59pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Medeama SC made it three consecutive wins in the Ghana Premier League with a comfortable 2-0 victory over AshantiGold.
After a goalless first half, the defending champions broke the deadlock nine minutes into the second period, with Dominic Amponsah converting from the penalty spot after Emmanuel Annor was brought down in the box.
Medeama continued to press and doubled their advantage in the 71st minute through a fine finish from Prosper Owusu.
The victory keeps Medeama at the top of the league standings with 27 points, three clear of second-placed Accra Hearts of Oak, while AshantiGold drop to seventh.
